data.name: Aniruddha
data.gender_notes: Aniruddha is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit a, 'not', + nir, 'out', + rudh, 'to obstruct' — 'unobstructed'. Its root is Sanskrit a + nir + rudh. Aniruddha, grandson of Krishna. Aniruddha is a Sanskrit name meaning “Unobstructed; unopposed”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aniruddha expresses “Unobstructed; unopposed”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit a, 'not', + nir, 'out', + rudh, 'to obstruct' — 'unobstructed'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aniruddha total 44, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

faq.q: What is the historical or scriptural reference for Aniruddha?
What is the lucky number for Aniruddha?
faq.a: The Pythagorean lucky number for Aniruddha is 8 (ruling planet Saturn). This is an interpretive association, not a factual claim.

faq.q: Which day is associated with Aniruddha?
faq.a: Saturday is the traditional association for Aniruddha. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which gemstone is associated with Aniruddha?
faq.a: Blue Sapphire is the traditional association for Aniruddha. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which colours are associated with Aniruddha?
faq.a: Blue, Black are the traditional associations for Aniruddha. These are interpretive.

faq.q: What is the numerology of Aniruddha?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aniruddha total 44, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

faq.q: How reliable is the meaning given for Aniruddha?
faq.a: The meaning of Aniruddha carries confidence HIGH in this record. It is established by classical lexicography or scripture.

faq.q: Does Aniruddha have a religious meaning?
faq.a: Aniruddha is recorded as a hindu name meaning “Unobstructed; unopposed”.

faq.q: What is the English meaning of Aniruddha?
faq.a: In English, Aniruddha is rendered as “Unobstructed; unopposed”.

faq.q: Is Aniruddha suitable for a baby?
faq.a: Aniruddha is used as a male given name; suitability is a personal choice.

faq.q: What is the full form of Aniruddha?
faq.a: Aniruddha is the full recorded form; any short forms are listed in the nicknames field.

faq.q: Which culture uses the name Aniruddha?
faq.a: Aniruddha is used in Sanskrit naming traditions.
